expected_summary.interpretation: The paired comparison fits the calibrator on one excluded match and assesses the other excluded match, in both directions for each base fold. It is not the full nested study with four calibration-training matches. The guard fits on six OOF development matches. All uncertainty summaries are descriptive because of historical reuse and shared base fits. Historical hyperparameter and recipe selection reused development matches. Excluding direct training ancestry does not undo that reuse. Results are development evidence, including any historically reused guard match.

interpretation: Development comparison with six paired assessment matches and one separate historically reused guard. Shared upstream fits and historical recipe selection preclude an independent test claim. Hashes verify consistency of the declared ancestry, not the truthfulness of undeclared upstream training.
